form.system.packages.uninstall.start.sub: Remove installed applications and extensions from this workspace.
form.system.packages.uninstall.start.des: Select the packages to uninstall. The selection is checked first; a confirmation task then shows what uninstalling removes, and nothing is removed until you confirm there. A package that another installed package requires can only be uninstalled together with it.
